field.label: Engine
field.comment: How email, CMS and newsletter templates are rendered in this scope. Legacy uses Magento's filter only. Shadow also renders each template through the new engine and records where the two differ, but always serves the legacy result, so customers see no change. Parser serves the new engine's result; any template it declines is rendered by Magento's filter instead. Run bin/magento template:shadow:report before switching a store view to Parser.

field.label: Parser Comparison Rate (%)
field.comment: The percentage of Parser renders also rendered by Magento's filter and compared, so a difference that appears after switching still shows up in template:shadow:report. The new engine's result is served either way. 0 turns the comparison off.
